description: Files of the MeshCentral fork package that are not byte-equal to the pinned npm meshcentral@1.2.5 (test/lib/meshcentral_upstream_reference.json), checked by test/meshcentral_upstream_base_contract.js. enforced: the CRLF-normalised diff against the reference must equal upstream-base/<path>.diff exactly. pending-rebase: the file starts from forkBase, not 1.2.5, and still lacks upstream changes; it is reported until flipStage rebases it. generated: a derived copy whose content generated-assets.json governs. fork-only: not in the upstream package. removed: upstream package files the fork does not ship. A byte-equal file needs no entry.

agentcertificatehistory.js.reviewed: Server module that keeps agent certificate history; copy of MeshAgent tools/configure_agent_certificate_history.js (checked equal by agent_certificate_history_configuration_runtime).

agents/meshcore.js.reviewed: Not reviewed hunk by hunk yet. Fork areas: native file actions, clipboard rewrite, service/process error reporting, Windows run commands via MeshConsoleBridgeW, win-terminal terminals, upload/download cleanup, desktop audio protocol 20, self-update hardening. Lacks upstream registry tunnel/consent and module split (#8072, #7690), Windows updates, software/printers (#7939), linux-info hang (#7904) and more.

meshcentral.js.reviewed: Production's loader (sha256 68c45084), formerly patched at deploy time by deploy.py.
